title: ALCops: The Next Chapter of LinterCop
summary: ALCops is a new community-driven code analyzer collection for AL that succeeds LinterCop, with about 95% of the original rules migrated. It provides VS Code extension and AL-Go support for daily AL development, with future work on Azure DevOps integration and AI tool compatibility.
key_points: ALCops is a fresh start community project built on the foundation of BusinessCentral.LinterCop, allowing breaking changes without damaging existing setups
The original LinterCop repository will transition to read-only as development resources concentrate on ALCops
Current v0.5.0 covers 95% of LinterCop rules with VS Code and AL-Go support, ready for daily AL development use
Future roadmap includes Azure DevOps extension, AI agent integration (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot), and potential MCP integration

quotes.text: Starting fresh meant we could allow breaking changes without damaging existing setups.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the strategic advantage of creating a new project rather than continuing LinterCop maintenance

quotes.text: my focus will be on expanding DevOps integrations and exploring better interaction with agent-based AI tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot.
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates the emerging direction for ALCops toward AI and automation integration
